M7.L1.title: Sort and record data into a table using up to four categories; use category counts to solve word problems.

M7.L2.title: Draw and label a picture graph to represent data with up to four categories.

M7.L3.title: Draw and label a bar graph to represent data; relate the count scale to the number line.

M7.L4.title: Draw a bar graph to represent a given data set.

M7.L5.title: Solve word problems using data presented in a bar graph.

M7.L6.title: Recognize the value of coins and count up to find their total value.

M7.L7.title: Solve word problems involving the total value of a group of coins.

M7.L8.title: Solve word problems involving the total value of a group of bills.

M7.L9.title: Solve word problems involving different combinations of coins with the same total value.

M7.L10.title: Use the fewest number of coins to make a given value.

M7.L11.title: Use different strategies to make $1 or make change from $1.

M7.L12.title: Solve word problems involving different ways to make change from $1.

M7.L13.title: Solve two-step word problems involving dollars or cents with totals within $100 or $1.

M7.L14.title: Solve problems related to saving and spending.

M7.L15.title: Understand the difference between consumers and producers.

M7.L16.title: Understand the difference between borrowing and lending.

M7.L17.title: Connect measurement with physical units by using iteration with an inch tile to measure.

M7.L18.title: Apply concepts to create inch rulers; measure lengths using inch rulers.

M7.L19.title: Measure various objects using inch rulers and yardsticks.

M7.L20.title: Develop estimation strategies by applying prior knowledge of length and using mental benchmarks.

M7.L21.title: Measure an object twice using different length units and compare; relate measurement to unit size.

M7.L22.title: Measure to compare the differences in lengths using inches, feet, and yards.

M7.L23.title: Solve two-digit addition and subtraction word problems involving length by using strip diagrams and writing equations to represent the problem.

M7.L24.title: Identify unknown numbers on a number line diagram by using the distance between numbers and reference points.

M7.L25.title: Represent two-digit sums and differences involving length by using the ruler as a number line.
